summary.en-US: Preview, consolidate, and organize Firefox tabs into native groups using deterministic local rules.

description.en-US:
Consolidate normal browser windows and organize loose tabs into Firefox's native groups. Preview full-window organization before applying it, preserve pinned tabs and existing groups, and undo the most recent action.

Start with built-in rules or create your own ordered rules for hostnames, URL text, and title text. Exclude unwanted matches, merge exact-name groups, and import or export your rules.

Right-click selected tabs to auto-sort them or move matching tabs into a rule group. These context-menu actions apply immediately to the selection. Undo asks for confirmation if tracked tabs have changed since the last action.

Everything runs locally. No accounts, payment, network requests, analytics, or page-content inspection. Tab inventory export is optional and removes credentials. Query strings and fragments are omitted unless explicitly enabled. Source code and support are available on GitHub.

version.approval_notes: The extension runs locally, makes no network requests, and does not load remote code. It reads tab titles and URLs only to preview and apply user-configured organization rules. Detailed logging excludes titles and URLs.
